description: This file contains functions related to system boot process, including hook management, pivoting root filesystems, and overlay setup, primarily used during system initialization in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating the start of splice hooks during boot.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the execution of splice hooks, exporting relevant variables.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a new hook and appends it to the stack.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specific hook's list for execution.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the first function from a hook's list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions associated with a specific hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation, changing the root filesystem.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots the root over it.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates a RAM-based overlay filesystem for temporary root storage.
